chunks: Humayd ibn Ziyad from al-Husayn ibn Muhammad from someone else from Aban ibn Uthman from Yahya ibn Abi al-'Ala' (peace be upon him) from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) that he used to say:
At his sleep time: I believe in Allah and disbelieve in al-Taghut. O Allah, protect me in my sleep and in my waking.

key_terms.الطَّاغُوت: Idols or those who exceed bounds in divinity/authority

ai.seo_question: What is the recommended supplication to recite before sleeping according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Recorded in *Al-Kafi* by Shaykh al-Kulayni, this hadith highlights the Imami tradition of integrating core theological tenets into daily rituals, specifically the declaration of *Tawhid* and rejection of *Taghut* before sleep. This practice serves as a spiritual safeguard, ensuring that the believer’s transition into unconsciousness is accompanied by conscious remembrance of God, thereby maintaining spiritual continuity between wakefulness and sleep.
